publicBrandingPolicy: Supplier and manufacturer names must NEVER appear on public-facing pages. All products are branded as The Corporate Desk collections.

FSZ.strengths: Broadest range — 124 SKUs. Covers executive desks, boardroom, workstations, storage. Strong series identity (Weiyi, Ruige, Evidenza, Fessenz/Four Color).
FSZ.bestFor: Medium-to-large open plan fitouts, manager suites, boardroom tables

GOJO.strengths: Zingana African zebrawood, pure copper hardware, mortise-and-tenon joinery. Vol 2 collections (JN, YOM, HXM) are heritage-meets-contemporary — strongest luxury positioning in the range.
GOJO.bestFor: C-suite offices, law firm partners' offices, executive boardrooms, luxury reception areas
GOJO.pricingNote: GOJO Vol 2 desks from $2,500+ — position as investment pieces, not commodity furniture

HSG.strengths: Height-adjustable sit-stand desks — electric, dual-motor, memory presets. Certified: SGS, BIFMA, FCC, CE. 21 SKUs across Milan, Karen, Owen, Baggio, Cape, Better series.
HSG.bestFor: Health-conscious workplaces, tech companies, ergonomic compliance upgrades

GOJO_LOUNGE.strengths: Leather sofas, sintered stone coffee tables, swivel lounge chairs. Complements GOJO executive suites perfectly.
GOJO_LOUNGE.bestFor: Reception areas, boardroom waiting areas, executive breakout spaces

GAOJIN.strengths: 53 individual product images. G01–G07 seating series, 833/842 training seating, K01–K03 lounge systems, stackable chairs. Best value commercial seating in the range.
GAOJIN.bestFor: Training rooms, conference seating, open plan visitor chairs, breakout lounge seating

crossSupplierBundling: Executive Suite: GOJO executive desk + GOJO lounge seating + FSZ boardroom table + HSG sit-stand for support staff
Manager Suite: FSZ manager desk + GAOJIN task chairs + FSZ storage
Training Room: FSZ boardroom/conference table + GAOJIN 842 training chairs
Reception: FSZ reception station + GOJO Lounge sofas + GAOJIN occasional tables
supplierLeverageNotes: Never reveal supplier identities to clients. Position all products as The Corporate Desk's own curated range. Multiple suppliers = flexibility; single client sees one coherent brand.
stockAvailabilityApproach: Confirm stock availability before committing to fast-track timelines. Never promise delivery without confirming with supplier first.
